title: MACS J0717.5+3745 · F814W / convergence audit derivative

display.kappaUnit: dimensionless convergence from source product; area-mean aggregated

provenance.derivativeMethod: Each 128×128 output cell is the finite-pixel area mean of one non-overlapping bin on the 4000×4000 Sharon WCS. No lens-map interpolation is performed in this step.

limitations: Use v4cor, not v4orig: STScI marks the original Sharon v4 scaling as incorrect. The convergence normalization and constrained region must be read from the map-maker documentation.
The web derivative is for inspection and teaching, not publication-grade measurement.
Area aggregation removes angular-resolution information; use the full FITS products for inference.
Only the Sharon/Johnson v4cor (corrected 2018-08-24) reconstruction is bundled for this target, so between-team systematics are absent.
F814W surface brightness is a morphology proxy, not a stellar-mass map.
